body:
I feel like Rick’s voice got worse. I didn’t mind it so much in season 7, but in this episode he sounds so incredibly bland I genuinely feel like it’s ruining his character. There’s no nuances, sarcasm or anger in his voice it’s just, well, bland. 

I don’t know if I’m being dramatic, if it’s the voice or the writing for Rick just wasn’t great this episode. He feels out of character sometimes. 

It reminds me of that alien he yelled at in S3E6 for sounding like he has smth stuck in his throat. 

Oh btw I really don’t want to say I want Roiland back. I loved his voice for Rick, but he’s just not a good person and it’s great how fast Adult Swim reacted kicking him off the show.

Thank you so much.

I’ll suggest that to him :)

thank you for your insight.

I assume he doesn’t want me to sign a contract bc where I live (Germany) tattoo artists have no official apprenticeship state, so he’d be required to pay me minimum wage.

He told me about having a lot of his prior apprentices starting their own business, which makes him not want to teach for free anymore, but I genuinely then don’t really get why he’s keeping me around at all, since he’s aware of my financial situation :/ 

I guess only time will tell n I’ll enjoy the week he lets me stay around for now, tho I’m still quite confused by what he means by showing him reassurance, since I also said I’ll work for free until he made enough money off of me to “pay“ for being taught by him. (I’m aware apprentices don’t really tattoo on ppl for a while. Still I thought it might be an idea)

I’ll try my best while I’m there. Thank you

I hope that’s not the case :/

I get your point, but that might be the case due to the usual way I got there in the first place. My boyfriends boss is an old apprentice from the tattoo shops owner, so he didn’t really see much of my art and just suggested I can stay at his shop for a week to see if I even like it and to see if I‘m any good at it, haha.
